answer: Require every agent to prove a distinct network home by latency triangulation. Step 1: three beacons ping the agent and record round-trip times. Step 2: the claimed location must match the measured triangle within 50 km. Step 3: a mismatch flags the identity, freezes its earnings, and triggers manual review. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real servers in 1,000 places at $5 each per month, $5,000 a month plus setup time no script can skip. Like opal hidden in basalt, a true signal only shines when the rock around it is real, and a copied gem crumbles under the test.
